title.zh: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum
title.en: Paxos’ $3B USDG stablecoin launches on Arbitrum

current_state.zh: Paxos' $3B Global Dollar (USDG) stablecoin launched natively on Arbitrum One with DeFi integrations, Kraken support and Stargate bridging, alongside an ArbitrumDAO proposal to earmark 100 million ARB for adoption incentives and liquidity.
